newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms seek 20,000T U.S. wheat-traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms seek 20,000T U.S. wheat-traders.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have joinlty invited tenders to buy a total of 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, traders said.
Of the total, Cheiljedang wants to buy 8,300 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges, including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour is seeking the remaining 11,700 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for June 15-July 15 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
